brief: Doc 32 Q-CF-44, Q-CF-47: fixture-seeded opposing forces, authored as content. A raider is a party of armed hulls one NPC leader stands behind, and the fixture carrier they launch from, seeded on a named frontier site by staff (@field/raiders <id>): the carrier on the ground at its cell, the hulls aboard. @field/raiders/launch <id> puts the hulls on the ground beside the carrier's ramp; @field/raiders/withdraw <id> orders them home up it. The hulls fly the kernel's doctrine (each hull's ROM seal, Standard Doctrine) and the leader holds a standing Hostile mark on every other party in any field it is admitted to. No generator, no respawn, no patrol: a seeded raider stays until it is destroyed, and seeding it again is refused while any of its hulls stands.
